title: Checkpoint keys are lowercase but the loader asks for uppercase
goal: Reproduce the documented experiment and determine why the validation accuracy does not match the documented result. Fix the repository so it reproduces the documented result.

symptom.pattern: KeyError|not a file in the archive

ground_truth.description: load_state_dict looks up W1/B1/W2/B2 while the released checkpoint stores w1/b1/w2/b2.
